handoffs.change: Measure kind 'scrub-sentence' scroll stars by their scrub range (the 92%→52% window = 40vh + the sentence height), or exempt that kind from the ≥ 300 px span rule.
handoffs.why: The ScrubSentence primitive puts the scroll star on the inline sentence span, which is about 60–110 px tall. The beats probe will flag B42, and B08/B21/B55 the same way, as spans < 300 px, and exits 1 on that.

handoffs.change: Treat B45 (the horse zone inside the sticky journal page) as a sticky beat, or accept 'B44 × B45 competing'.
handoffs.why: The probe measures at scrollY 0, so it reads the zone's unstuck box, about 0.7 V below the spread top. That overlaps B44's ±50vh. At runtime they never collide: the zone mounts only after the first entry crosses the reading line, and the fly is needsIdle.

handoffs.why: Under the voices.fire ALT (fireside-loop), the rd-fire hotspot and flare only render when the plate has a `fire` mark. MV-11 has none, so the ALT has no on-page rd-fire trigger. The DEFAULT camp has the mark and works.

notes: I did not run anything in a browser: this is a shared tree, and next dev/build/start are not allowed. Checks run: npx tsc --noEmit (my files clean), npx eslint on all my files (clean), npm run check (exit 0, 71 warnings).
Out of my globs: tsc at one point reported TS2322 in components/site/contact-scene.tsx:277/279 (W3-HP, mid-edit); it was gone on the last run. I did not touch it.

FrontierBand, a taste call for P3-11: the spec now has the camera continue the card's push 1.04→1.08 toward the sun. Under the boot gate the band therefore starts at ×1, not the P3-0 ×1.2 close-up (rdr2.module.css .bandZoom). Everywhere else (phones, touch, RM, no JS) the static ×1.2 framing is unchanged. The ALT's Dead Eye layer keeps ×1.2.
B41 fix: below 90rem, under the boot gate, the TrailMap breaks out across the whole Athletics note. The map is about 302–416 px tall at 1024–1439 and unchanged at ≥ 1440.

B46 moved from the camp stage to writing.tsx's dusk, as deferred #16 suggested. Under the boot gate the dusk room grows to max(18vh, 19.5rem − section pad), so the star spans ≥ 312 px. B47 is now on the camp stage root in both variants.

DEFAULT journal: vignettes now also swap as entries cross the reading line, with hover taking priority. Drafts stay non-link DRAFT. The vignette page carries 'Entry III' in the hand face (font-world-hand, 2 words: existing microcopy, glyphs covered by the HAND_BASE cut).
The rd-bone note is set in Newsreader italic, not the hand face, because the spec caps the hand at ≤ 4 words per page and the note is 5 words. Aryan or P3-11 can choose the hand instead.

Wired unsigned copy, already on the DP-9 list: egg.hunt.name.rd-eagle and egg.hunt.name.rd-bone (hotspot aria-labels), egg.hunt.hint.rd-fire, egg.bone.note, egg.fire.toast (runtime). In production, hotspots and the note render only once the copy is signed (copyVisible).

HTML weight for the assembler: HORSE_FRAMES puts about 24 KB of path data (≈ 9.7 KB gz) into the server HTML, and again into the RSC payload, on every device. If that matters for Phase 4, the fly binder could fetch the frames lazily instead.
Under the plates.loops ALT preview, the WANTED board drifts as one group, without lib/loops in the first load: drift = handbill ALT or plates.loops ALT.
